needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked pedestrian crossing at this busy junction to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at both sides of the marked crossing to allow wheelchair users and those with mobility aids to access the footway safely.
Install street lighting along this urban road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
